general.notes: Copper (RJ-45) 1000BASE-T transceiver over Category 5 UTP; not an optical module. LP-SFP-MS8I ordering: 1000Mbps only, SERDES interface, -40~85°C, Marvel 88E1111. Features also list commercial case temp 0 to +70°C and industrial -40 to +85°C. Table 5 data rate 10 to 1,000 Mb/sec (comma as thousands separator). Cable length 100 m at BER <10-12. Power consumption and surge current stated higher than SFP MSA values. Supply current max 375 mA; typical power 1.05 W. Line frequency 125 MHz with 5-level encoding per IEEE 802.3.
